description: Job Records: submit one job’s records (payments received for the job, payments made during it, compute or model spend and failed-run costs, each with amount, asset and label) with the job’s stated deliverable and, where you have it, the count of finished outputs. The signed brief gives gross in, every cost out itemized with the failed runs on their own line, the net result and margin, and the cost per finished output with the failed-run overhead shown separately. Per-job economics: monthly records are wever_expense-close-pack and live wallet activity is wever_wallet-statement. Verdict loss, break_even or profitable. POST /api/job-cost-brief. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, wallet or merchant lookup, order, payment or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/job-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/job-records/.

asset.description: Asset for records that state none.

compute_spend.description: Compute or model spend for the job. Each with amount, asset, label, reference, job_reference and date.

deliverable.description: The stated output or deliverable of the job.

failed_runs.description: The cost of each failed run. Each with amount, asset, label, reference, job_reference and date.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

output_count.description: How many finished outputs the job produced.

output_unit.description: What one output is, such as "report" or "image".

payments_made.description: Payments made during the job. Each with amount, asset, label, reference, job_reference and date.

payments_received.description: Payments received for the job. Each with amount, asset, label, reference, job_reference and date.

name: wever_job-cost-brief
